scope: frozen-result/figure replay; no refitting or event-level reproduction

external_training_archive.scope: Full moment-derived central_values and cross-design/cross-bin covariance; NOT the accepted pinned old-table means. Separate audit archive, not required to draw figures.

external_accepted_tables.scope: Bytewise accepted frozen observables.h5: Design/Design_indices/Prediction, validation tables, and experimental inputs. Accepted old 134-bin prediction means are not replaced by moment-derived central_values in full_training.npz.

source_checkout_anchors.author_analysis_sources: Exact SHA256 snapshots authoritative; not necessarily tracked in either commit

coordinate_convention: q = physical pi*T*Lres on [0,20]; u is unit-square resolution input, not q; kappa in [0.3,0.6]
omissions: No grid-point prediction_mean/prediction_variance or loglike arrays: full posterior masses and saved predictive quantiles retained.
No event records, optimizer reruns, emulator loads or inference. Native model checkpoints are a separate validation task.
